resources.string: The answers of this practice are lost.
In the validation, the long session starts right after the short one.
The validation screens with the sample flips of the Idena web app. Nothing is sent.
Short session: %1$d flips in 2 minutes. For each flip, tap the story that makes sense.

Long session: %1$d flips in %1$d minutes. Solve them, then check the keywords of each flip (the stories cannot change after that): approve it, or report it (up to %2$d flips) when a keyword is not in the story, numbers or letters show the order, it needs reading text, or it lists objects instead of telling a story. Then mark one approved flip as the best. Submit comes once every flip is answered.
%1$d of %2$d flips to report (%3$d reports allowed)
%1$s You cannot change the answers afterwards.

The rules of the keyword check
Approve or report every flip: %1$d of %2$d.
Mark the best flip with ★ to submit.
%1$d of %2$d flips solved; %3$d approved, %4$d reported, the best marked.
No flip is approved: the node will ignore your grades.

Approve a flip when its story shows both keywords. Report it when a keyword is not in the story, numbers or letters show the order, it needs reading text, or it lists objects instead of telling a story. Report at most %1$d of these %2$d flips and mark one approved flip as the best (★): more makes the node ignore all your grades. Submit comes once every flip with keywords is approved or reported and the best is marked. Tap a picture to see it full screen. The stories cannot be changed any more.

resources.string: Tell a short story in four pictures that uses both words:

Make the story clear for people and not for a computer: the order of the pictures must matter. No text, letters or numbers in the pictures, no violence. One of the four will be a nonsense \"anti-AI\" picture.
The story, in order. Tap a picture to change it.
This is the nonsense picture that makes the flip hard for AI. It is made from your story pictures. Move it with ◀ ▶.
This is the nonsense picture that makes the flip hard for AI. It is made from %1$d search pictures. Move it with ◀ ▶.

The search asks three services directly from this phone: DuckDuckGo, Openverse and Wikimedia Commons. Each sees the phone\'s internet address and the words searched. Only pictures are shown, never web pages, and each comes from the service that found it. Everything else in the app talks only to your own node.
Tap a picture to use it. \"Use for anti-AI\" takes 8 of these for the nonsense picture.
Getting pictures for the anti-AI picture…
Not enough pictures could be read.
Left: the story. Right: the same pictures in an order that breaks it. At the validation, people see both and pick the one that makes sense. Tap two pictures on the right to swap them.
The right side still tells the story: shuffle it more.
The node encrypts the flip, keeps it on IPFS and publishes it with a transaction signed by your identity. A flip has no fee.
Keep the node running until the validation: it hands out the keys of your flips then.
This identity state cannot submit flips.
Flips cannot be sent once the flip lottery has started.
refuses searches from this connection for now; try again in a few minutes.
Asking the node for the fee…
The node refuses to delete it: %1$s
Flip deleted: its words can be used for a new flip.
Without %1$d more, the identity becomes %2$s at the validation.
Flips are made and deleted outside the validation.
The flip leaves the validation and its words can be used again. Fee: %1$s.
Then %1$d of %2$d required flips are made: make another before the flip lottery, or the identity becomes %3$s.
As validators see it: the story and the shuffled story, in a random order.
